definition: [ שְׁרִיקָה ] noun [feminine] hissing , perhaps also whistling, piping ; — plural absolute (intensive) שְׁרִיקֹת Jer 18:16 Qr hissing , in derision, + שַׁמָּה (see שְׁרֵקָה ), Kt שרוקת ; construct שְׁרִקוֺת עֲדָרִים Judg 5:16 as signal hissings (or whistlings, pipings) for flocks .
